title: crinum album
intro: Crinum album, commonly known as the White Lily or Wild Garlic, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, as it has been used to treat various health conditions, including fever, respiratory issues, and digestive problems. The health benefits of Crinum album include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as soothing fever, relieving cough, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
